title: api: add JSON Schema structured output support and strict response_format
author: Asha Raman
description: Adds first-class JSON Schema structured output support to the API surface via a new 'response_format' parameter, plus a 'strict' validation mode and improved error messages. Motivation: customers need deterministic machine-readable outputs for downstream parsing and safety checks; ad-hoc heuristics are brittle. This PR implements: 1) response_format=json_schema: accepts a JSON Schema (draft-07 compatible subset) and returns structured outputs validated against the schema. 2) strict=true|false: when strict=true the runtime rejects completions that do not validate and surfaces a detailed validation error; when strict=false the runtime returns the best-effort parse and includes validation warnings in metadata. 3) Streaming behavior: streaming mode now emits partial chunks but defers final schema validation until EOF; if strict=true and final output fails validation the stream ends with a terminal error event and the response metadata contains the validation diff. For strict=false, streaming includes inline "validation_warnings" events to guide consumers. 4) OpenAI-compat layer: added mapping for OpenAI's response_format and function-calling surface so existing integrations can opt-in with minimal changes. 5) SDK/compat tests and e2e assertions: added Python and TS SDK tests for strict and permissive modes and a canary integration test that simulates a schema-mismatch in streaming. 6) Error messaging: standardized error codes (structured_output.validation_failed, structured_output.partial_parse) and human- and machine-friendly messages. 7) Docs and examples: API docs updated with examples showing schema definition, strict handling, and recommended retry/rollback patterns. Checklist: - [x] Runtime schema validator + tests - [x] Streaming adjustments + terminal error event - [x] OpenAI compatibility mapping - [x] SDK tests (py/ts) - [x] Documentation examples - [x] Release notes entry Breaking changes: none; default behavior unchanged unless callers opt into response_format=json_schema. Backwards-compat: callers who don't set response_format are unaffected. Migration notes and recommendations included in the release_notes field.
